messages:
leah_csm: Quick sync — follow-up on the HarborPoint surge yesterday. We saw repeated 503s for ~45m. Need owners + action items for customer note and RCA.

sam_support: Logs point to model fallback to a smaller quantized variant at 02:14 UTC, spike to ~2.1% error rate. I started a request capture.

aj_devops: Deployed a memory-guard patch at 02:42 (deploy/1870) and forced KV cache clears. Error rate dropped to ~0.2% after that.

marco_ae: Customer reported latency blips before the 503s. They're asking for timeline and interim mitigation now.

leah_csm: Who can own the customer message (ETA 4h)? Also need an RCA doc + action items in Confluence.

sam_support: I can own the RCA doc, ETA EOD. I'll attach logs and p95 plots. Link to capture: https://logs.redwood.internal/harborpoint/187000

aj_devops: I'll own the mitigation (KV persistence tuning + canary config). Plan: reproduce in staging, stress test, push config by tomorrow 10am PT.

marco_ae: I'll draft the customer note and run it by legal. Will call out temporary mitigations and timelines.

leah_csm: OK assignments: sam = RCA, aj = mitigation, marco = customer comms. Please add a 1pm PT postmortem invite.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1870004321 — https://incident.redwood/INC-187000

aj_devops: quick log snippet for context:
```
2026-03-19T02:14:22Z ERROR model-serving HTTP/1.1 503 internal - fallback triggered
model-fallback: kv_cache_miss -> oom_reclaim -> worker-restart
stack: runtime/kv_cache.go:241 -> runtime/serve.go:89
```

sam_support: Added action items to the ticket with owners and tentative SLAs. Also uploaded p95 latency chart.

leah_csm: :thumbsup: Thanks. Can someone capture cost delta for the fallback period? Customer asked about billing impact.

marco_ae: On it — preliminary estimate is +$2.1k/day during the spike window (using committed capacity rates). Will include in customer note.

aj_devops: I will post the staging repro results here once complete.

sam_support: FYI tagging @leah_csm in the RCA when ready.

leah_csm: Closing loop for now — postmortem invite sent, reconvene after mitigation tests. Thanks team.
